decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
Condition : 3 - A sample tile showing the proposed colour and texture shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commence of the works.
Condition : 4 - Tiles that are in a complete and reusable condition will be carefully removed and stored on site for reuse on the building.

Condition : 5 - Full details with sections (at 1:20 or as appropriate) and method statements of new, reused and repair work to the lantern light shall be provided on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commence of works.
description: Replace hanging tiles on front and side of house and replace structural timbers of roof over hallway, rebuild glass & timber light over hallway, remake surrounding flat roof (Listed Building Application)
